candidates.description: These tokens represent common French adverbs and conjunctive adverbs used to modify clauses, express sequence, or indicate emphasis and frequency.
This feature vector activates on German-derived surnames, historical proper nouns, and morphemes containing "Re" or related name-like roots.
This vector activates strongly on the letter sequence "ss" and words containing it.
These tokens represent demonstrative determiners and pronouns in French.
This vector represents the concept of scale, size, or magnitude across multiple languages.
This vector represents concepts related to France, French culture, and major European locations and nationalities.
This feature vector activates on French adjectival and nominal suffixes indicating relation, profession, or quality.
This vector represents first-, second-, and third-person personal pronouns primarily in French.
This vector activates for words and proper nouns related to Japan, its cities, and associated cultural terms.
This vector represents historical figures, predominantly figures and names associated with the 20th century, particularly of German or European origin.
